def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Extend the separator between the two color-2 components across the grid in color 3.
    for r, row in enumerate(out):
        if all(value == 0 for value in row):
            above = any(v == 2 for v in out[r - 1]) if r > 0 else False
            below = any(v == 2 for v in out[r + 1]) if r + 1 < len(out) else False
            if above and below:
                out[r] = [3] * len(row)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
    for c in range(2,6):
        demo[2][c] = 2; demo[6][c] = 2
    for r in (3,5):
        demo[r][2] = demo[r][5] = 2
    expected = [row[:] for row in demo]
    expected[4] = [3]*10
    assert transform(demo) == expected
    test = [[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
    for r in (1,2,3,5):
        for c in range(1,5): test[r][c] = 2
    result = transform(test)
    assert result[4] == [3]*10
    print(result)
PY
